insights.one_liner: LvH Corporate Finance is an 8-person Amsterdam M&A and valuations boutique offering a paid finance internship, though it asks for Dutch.

culture.text: An independent corporate finance boutique founded in 2014, doing valuations and M&A, affiliated with accountancy firm Londen & Van Holland.
A close-knit team of about 8 people working daily with around 80 colleagues from Londen & Van Holland.
Staff mostly studied economics, often at University of Amsterdam, VU or Maastricht.

open.text: Its one open job here, a finance internship in Amsterdam, shows the pay but is not marked as Dutch-free.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
The internship draws around 59 applicants on LinkedIn.
